text:
Maya: Heads up 1: Jeremy (data infra) turned in his resignation this morning. Last day 2026-05-07. He27s remote (EU) and requested remote pickup for laptop. Need to coordinate benefits end-of-month, COBRA packet timing, access removal, and a brief exit interview.

Ravi: Thanks Maya. Ravi (People Ops) here 1. Can Payroll confirm final pay date and whether bonus payouts are affected? Also tagging IT and Security for deprovision.

Payroll: Payroll 1 1. Final run scheduled 2026-05-10. Any pending expense reports submitted by 05/06 will be included. No retroactive bonus payments after resignation unless previously approved in writing. If Jeremy has a pro-rated commission, submit sales-ops ticket.

People Ops: We'll schedule exit interview and send the equipment return options. COBRA/continuation info for EU outplacement varies by country; we'll send the localized benefits wrap-up. For US-based employees, coverage runs through last day of termination month. For Jeremy (DE), we'll include statutory notices per local regs and provide contact for local benefits partner.

IT-Ops: IT-Ops here. Please confirm Jeremy's email (jeremy@redwood.com) and any service accounts he owns. Also confirm SSO groups with admin privileges.

Maya: jeremy@redwood.com. He has ownership of a GCS bucket used for team backups, service account backup-sa@project, and was a member of SSO group "data-admins" (temporary access during migration).

IT-Ops: We'll schedule deprovision 2026-05-08 08:00 UTC. Order: Okta -> GitHub -> GCP -> internal VPN -> Slack. We'll create a snapshot of IAM bindings and transfer bucket ownership. Note: need confirmation who will accept the GCS bucket transfer and service account ownership.

Jeremy: I can transfer the bucket to @Maya or @Ravi. For the service account, I created it for exports, Ben from infra should be set as owner. I27ll tidy the exports and leave a short doc. Laptop return 1 I prefer prepaid label to my EU address.

Ravi: People Ops will send the prepaid label and instructions. We'll collect a preferred personal email for admin follow-ups; retention policy is 12 months for admin contact.

Security: Quick note 1. Because Jeremy had access to production analytics, Security requires a quick credential rotation for downstream pipelines: rotate API keys that referenced backup-sa, and rotate any external integrations with GCS. We'll queue rotation for 2026-05-08 after deprovision.

Maya: Can we get a list of active tickets/PRs he owns? I can coordinate owners. We27ll need a 20-30 min knowledge transfer meeting before 2026-05-06.

Jeremy: I27ll post a list of open tickets and PRs by EOD tomorrow and schedule a 30-min handoff on 2026-05-05 10:00 UTC.

People Ops: COBRA/local benefits packet will be emailed 2026-05-08 (one business day after deprovision). For EU statutory wrap-up, we'll include final health admin contacts and pension/retirement transfer details.

Payroll: Confirming: any outstanding stock questions? Jeremy 1 had RSUs that vest on 2026-06-01. Vesting won't occur after termination unless governed by accelerated vesting clause. Payroll/People Ops will coordinate with Legal for the exact grant terms and share the equity FAQ.

Legal: Confirmed 1. Jeremy's RSUs follow standard schedule; no acceleration in his grant. He has 90 days for vested option exercise if applicable. We'll offer a one-on-one call to go over tax/treatment if he requests.

IT-Ops: Ticket OFF-5021 created for deprovision and asset return. Command: `offboard --user jeremy@redwood.com --deprovision 2026-05-08T08:00Z --transfer-owner maya@redwood.com --collect-assets`. Adding Maya and Ravi as approvers.

Maya: I'll accept the GCS bucket ownership and confirm once transfer completes.

Ravi: Scheduling exit interview 1 options: 2026-05-06 09:00 UTC or 2026-05-07 14:00 UTC. Jeremy, preference?

Jeremy: 2026-05-06 09:00 UTC works. Thanks everyone for being responsive.

People Ops: Exit interview booked. We'll send Jeremy the benefits packet and prepaid label on 2026-05-05. IT-Ops will run deprovision 2026-05-08 08:00 UTC and Security will rotate keys thereafter. Payroll final run 2026-05-10. Anything else?

Security: Please ensure service account keys are audited and rotated, and remove any CI secrets referencing his username.

Maya: Will coordinate transfer of PRs and ensure CI ownership updated by 2026-05-06.

Jeremy: Posting the PR list tonight and will be available for the 30-min handoff. Appreciate the assistance. :heart:
